description.en: Credit-linked support for setting up a new micro enterprise in the non-farm sector, implemented through KVIC, State KVIBs, District Industries Centres, and banks.

benefit_summary.en: A bank-financed project can receive margin-money subsidy under the programme. The applicable project ceiling, subsidy rate, own contribution, and bank terms depend on the activity, location, and applicant category.

eligibility_summary.en: Applicants must be at least 18 years old and propose an eligible new unit. Education requirements apply above specified project-cost thresholds, and eligible institutions can include SHGs, societies, production co-operatives, and charitable trusts. Current continuation and local implementation must be confirmed on the portal.

name.en: Identity and applicant details required by the portal and bank
Education or skill certificate when required for the proposed project
Special-category certificate when claiming that category's benefit
Rural-area certificate when claiming a rural-location benefit

instruction.en: Check the current PMEGP notice and eligible activity list on the official portal.
Prepare the project report and submit the online application with supporting documents.
Complete scrutiny, bank appraisal, and required training or registration steps communicated by the implementing agency.

citation.publisher: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises and KVIC
